name: PRODUCTS
house: House of Orange / ARCHON Psi Atelier
orthography_correction_note: Sibling-provided draft used 'CLAVSVS'. Corrected to 'CLAVSUS' per Lane S Day III.f canon (V/U disambiguation rule: CLAVSUS, not CLAVSVS).
scope: Lane P houses canon for ARCHON Psi product and service offerings: editioned physical Vehicles (garments, headwear), capacity-limited service deliverables (Briefs, Sprints, Retainers, Commissions), and the issuance discipline (SKU rules, price-lock, edition-cap, drift controls) that prevents commerce drift across surfaces. Anchored against canon-infra v1.0 attestation primitive.
governing_principles: Price drift is forbidden: price change requires a new SKU and a new receipt.
Edition drift is forbidden: edition cap change requires a new SKU and a new receipt.
Material drift is forbidden: material substitution requires a new SKU.
Chain Reference rule: chain = attested git history + receipt hashes (NOT blockchain).
'Jewel Core' is a Lane P reserved word for the provenance engine; physical Vehicles must be named by vehicle_type (Garment, Headwear, Writ, Sprint, etc.).

definitions.jewel_core: The provenance engine: receipt_id, hashes, sealing, access rights (unwearable authority token). Lane-P-scoped definition.
definitions.vehicle: The physical or digital object that carries the Jewel Core (garment, headwear, document, sprint deliverable).
definitions.editioned: Hard-capped physical/digital units with unit_serial and edition_cap.
definitions.capacity_limited: Service inventory limited by operator throughput windows, not unit counts.

name_collision_note.description: The term 'Jewel Core' has two distinct canonical meanings in this repo:

usage_a.definition: Provenance engine carried by a Vehicle (receipt + hashes + access rights).

usage_b.definition: Scoring doctrine: Jewel-Core = min(S, M). Lane-neutral.

name_collision_note.resolution_policy: Both definitions remain canonical in scope. Cross-references between scopes must use full disambiguated phrases: 'Lane P Jewel Core (provenance engine)' or 'canon-infra Jewel-Core Primitive (scoring rule)'. Future canon work may rename one or the other if drift becomes operationally costly.

drift_controls.forbidden_phrases_note: Use 'seal_hash (sha256)', 'receipt_id', and 'attested git reference' instead. Tokenization may be canon-opened in a future lane with explicit ratification.

deferred_items.description: Headwear Unit (Crown Protocol, $210 / 500 cap) classification: sub-tier T1-H vs T0 Accessory. Sibling-thread spec drafted but Lane P does not absorb without explicit one-word vote (T1-H or T0).
Weekly capacity caps for T2 / T3 / T4. Pending first-cohort throughput data.
Council-admission policy receipts. Pending governance lane or explicit policy commit.

notes: Lane P opened Day III.h under VOTE P-OPEN. Lifecycle DRAFT until at least one editioned SKU emits a complete receipt chain (submission_hash + seal_hash + unit_serial + attested git ref). On first complete issuance, lane advances to PROBATION.
